# Fonts for the synthetic scans

The fonts `riso testdata scans` renders invoices with (`riso/testdata/fonts.py`), vendored so a
page renders the same on every machine. Each family is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; its
`OFL.txt` is next to its files. They are unmodified copies from the Google Fonts repository,
`https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/<family>/`, downloaded on 2026-11-10; only
`Caveat-wght.ttf` is renamed (from `Caveat[wght].ttf`).
